newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HBG no comment on Wayss bid report.
newsitem.headline: HBG no comment on Wayss bid report.

text.p: Dutch construction group Hollandsche Beton Groep NV (HBG) said on Thursday it had no comment on a newspaper report it was considering buying a majority stake in German construction firm Wayss & Freytag.

An HBG spokesman said the company was interested in strengthening its activities in various sectors, especially electrical contracting in the Netherlands, and in various countries, especially Germany.
"We are talking to various parties. We don't mention names before there's a good chance of an agreement," the spokesman told Reuters.
Dutch daily De Volkskrant reported that HBG was interested in buying a stake of more than 70 percent in Wayss & Freytag, currently held by German industrial group AGIV.
AGIV last week told Reuters it was talking to an unnamed construction company about a possible sale of the shareholding.
Wayss & Freytag earned a net profit of 24.6 million marks in 1995 on turnover of more than two billion marks.
